fixture_scope: Synthetic deterministic policy evaluation; does not establish model quality or live provider activation.
label_method: Coordinator-authored expectations from Plan 050 product rules before the correction integration; no similarity function generated the labels.
case_schema_notes: Each case has explicit expected outcomes and rationale. Outcome labels describe policy semantics; the evaluator may map precise stable API error codes to these labels without weakening them.
Use the actual in-memory schema, evidence capture, candidate validation, canonical writers, and approval transaction. Do not return these labels from a fixture-only implementation.
Capture reviewed target revision/digest before any listed mutation. Build citations from the exact host-captured evidence bytes.
Discovery cases may call only the existing single injected reviewer; local comparison discovery must add zero provider calls.
Report every case and each group separately. Do not overwrite v1, baseline-v1, baseline-v2, composition-v1, or baseline-composition-v1.

cases.rationale: The same currently valid claim in the same scope and type needs no second canonical row.
Whitespace reflow does not change this claim.
Replacing a target with its unchanged body and semantic fields is a no-op.

evidence.subject: recorded_observation
evidence.quote: ALFRED-4821 no longer deploys to staging; that routing policy has been withdrawn.

cases.rationale: A retraction can quote the target without colliding with the target's own duplicate hash.
An expired row does not block a newly supported current fact.
Equal text in another workflow is not an in-scope duplicate.
A fact and a decision have separate typed identities; similarity cannot silently merge them.
A stable identifier in independent evidence should find the older routing fact behind 22 unrelated recent rows.
Fair source allocation should retain comparison material for both independent subjects.

canonical.title: Routing policy
canonical.body: The Paris office receives the staging report.

evidence.subject: recorded_observation
evidence.quote: The Madrid office receives the staging report.

proposal.title: Routing policy
proposal.body: The Madrid office receives the staging report.

cases.rationale: Shared report vocabulary does not make two different offices the same subject or prove a contradiction.
A destructive proposal cannot rely on a target preview that was not shown completely.

mutation.body: ALFRED-4821 deploys to a canary environment.

cases.rationale: Semantic revision must catch a same-timestamp target edit without overwriting the new claim.
Validity dates are semantic fields even when the target text and wall-clock edit timestamp stay unchanged.
Approval requires the candidate revision actually displayed, even for a title edit.
A retained proposal cannot approve a correction after its independently recorded source was deleted.
A future correction cannot supersede today's routing fact early or activate without a later explicit approval.
The start boundary is inclusive, and an explicit UTC offset denotes the same instant.
The end boundary is exclusive; a proposal already expired at approval cannot replace the current claim.
Approval today does not invent a new confirmation time or expiry for an observation recorded earlier.
A model-provided expiry with no supporting quote cannot become canonical metadata.
Two candidates targeting the same snapshot cannot both commit the same canonical correction.
